## Stubs

`vendor/stubs/` holds replacements that esbuild substitutes at bundle time (`scripts/render.mjs`,
plugin `vendor-stubs`); the real file is not copied.

| replaced module | stub | why |
|---|---|---|
| `tracker/src/components/FloatingWindow.tsx` | `vendor/stubs/components/FloatingWindow.tsx` | Imports `CombatantDetail`, which imports `StatBlock` (a cycle), plus `GmWidgets`, `dockDragStore`, `layoutStore` and uses `document`, `navigator.clipboard` and `fetch`. `PopupPreview` is only mounted as a `Tooltip`'s hover content, which a static render never opens, so the stub (renders nothing) cannot change any heading or text. `SpellTooltip` is re-exported by `TagRenderer` and never rendered by `StatBlock`. |

## Not copied (type-only imports, erased by esbuild)

`utils/turnTimer.ts` (from `combatStore.ts`), `utils/wanderersGuide.ts` (from `partyStore.ts`).

## Runtime environment the render assumes (contract sections 0 and 5)

- No `GameDataProvider`: the context default has empty maps, so nothing fetches and every trait, spell,
  action and equipment link renders as plain text. This changes wrapping elements only, never which rows
  appear.
- Settings store reset to `STATBLOCK_DEFAULT` (`spellLayout: 'grid'`, `spellIndicator: 'diamond'`)
  before every record; empty `localStorage`.
- Props `hideHP={false}`, `hideTraits={false}`, no `edit`; combatant with no conditions, not elite/weak,
  no `scaledToLevel`, no `resourceUses`.
- `ResizeObserver` stub (only reached by client rendering; `renderToStaticMarkup` runs no layout effects).
